Good afternoon, and welcome to Hotel Firenze. This is the guest information message. There is free Wi-Fi in all the rooms and in the lobby. The name of the network is HOTEL FIRENZE GUEST, and the password is on the small card next to the television. There is also a phone in every room. For reception, press number nine. There is no charger in the rooms, but there are two chargers at reception, and they are free for our guests. On the fifth floor the signal is sometimes weak, so please come down to the lobby for a long call. If there is a problem with the Wi-Fi, send a message to reception and we come to your room. Thank you, and have a good evening.

Hi Marlene, this is Paul. I am at the airport, and my battery is very low, so this message is short. There is a problem with my phone: the screen is broken and I cannot read your messages today. My flight arrives at eight o'clock tonight. There is a taxi in front of the airport, so please do not worry about me. Is there Wi-Fi in your hotel? Send the password to my email, not to my phone. See you tomorrow at the restaurant. Bye.

First, you arrive at the hotel and you ask if there is Wi-Fi. Then the receptionist gives you the password. Next, you look at the screen of your phone and you see that the battery is low. After that, you ask if there is a charger at reception. Finally, you send a message to your friend with the name of the hotel.
